findings_qualitative.value: No outflow signature (broad second component) seen in CO/[CI]; galaxy unresolved

evidence.quote: We do not find any signatures in the flux density profile for a CO or [CI] outflow

claims.hypothesis: Does the ISM of the cSFG resemble a starburst?
claims.finding: ISM conditions similar to local starbursts/ULIRGs

evidence.quote: This suggests that the molecular ISM in 3D-HST GS30274 is in a starburst phase.

claims.hypothesis: Is the gas depletion time short?

evidence.quote: All these approaches yield H$_2$ depletion times shorter than typically found in more extended main-sequence galaxies

claims.hypothesis: Are line widths gravitational from a compact gas reservoir?
claims.experiment: Compare observed sigma with predicted from Mdyn
claims.finding: Consistent with gravitational motions in compact reservoir

evidence.quote: the observed velocity dispersions are consistent with being gravitationally driven by a compact distribution of both stars and gas

why_this_method.value: [CI] is a better H2 tracer in cosmic-ray/X-ray dominated environments

evidence.quote: [CI] is a better tracer of the H$_2$ mass than CO.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Tex of ~200 K from PDR models rejected in favour of 30 K

evidence.quote: We therefore stick to the assumed excitation temperature of $T_{\rm ex} = 30$ K

limitations_admitted.value: Galaxy unresolved; outflows could be missed; needs higher resolution

evidence.quote: Future high-resolution observations are needed to properly measure the size of the compact molecular gas reservoir
